hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && if command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1; then uv run --quiet python scripts/claude_hooks.py guard-bash; else echo 'Project hooks need uv on PATH and cannot run, so Bash is blocked. Install uv or add it to PATH (README: Claude Code hooks).' >&2; exit 2; fi

cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && if command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1; then uv run --quiet python scripts/claude_hooks.py format-python; else echo 'Project hooks need uv on PATH – the edited file was not formatted (README: Claude Code hooks).' >&2; exit 2; fi
